findings.location: task.accepted[id=a4].text: "Mi padre es médico y es de Odessa."
findings.description: The standard Spanish spelling of the Ukrainian city is 'Odesa', with one s. The key accepts 'Odessa', a spelling used in other languages, as correct Spanish.
findings.suggestion: Remove a4; its correctly spelled equivalent is already accepted as a1.
